summary: Native Count* steps (CountArmyColor/Type/Kingdom, CountArmor...) run at their own step position, usually step 0, before any damage. Engine modifier sources (alliesOfColor, enemiesOfColor, alliesOfRace, ...) are evaluated lazily when the consuming segment runs, so a unit killed by an earlier segment of the same spell is no longer counted. weapon:1158 Runeforger: CountArmyColor@AllAllies/AllEnemies Brown, then SplashHighDamage, then ExplodeGems: a Brown enemy killed by the splash must still add one explosion. Needs count sources captured at cast start (or at the native Count step position), like castStartBoardSkulls. Also troop:7492 (Undead/Daemon enemies counted before Angel-gem explosion skulls), troop:6593 (Divine enemies counted before Damage@AllEnemies kills). Where the counted segment could simply be moved ahead without an observable change (troop:7883) sa-R1 reordered the curated skill instead.
repro: castSpell({key:"weapon:1158", target:11, enemies:[{hp:600,armor:5,colors:["Red"]},{hp:1,maxHp:1,armor:0,colors:["Brown"]}]}) -> splash kills E11, then explode uses 1 centre (caster only); native: 2.

summary: troop:6964 StormKnight native order: CountArmyColor@FromTarget Blue, DestroyColumn [AddForBlueTarget], IncreaseAttack@Self, TrueDamage@FromTarget last (R001). The only available gate, lastTargetColor, needs a prior targeting segment, so the curated skill must deal the true damage first. Observable: if the chosen target is the front enemy, native column skulls hit it before the true damage; the engine kills it first and column skulls go to the next enemy. Needs a global condition on the chosen target colour (chosenTargetColor, symmetric to chosenTargetRace), then 8467 can be reordered. sa-R1 already fixed the count (target only, not all Blue enemies).
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:6964 -> L10 "dmg E11 12 ; destroy 8 ... ; buff C attack+5" (native: destroy, buff, then dmg).

summary: Native CountGems <Color> BoardTarget Row counts only the gems in the targeted row, captured before the row is exploded. With ExplodeGems BoardTarget Row the explosion also clears the neighbouring rows, so destroyedGems overcounts and boardGems (current curated 8928) reads the whole board (L10 dmg 178 vs native about 26 + 8 x row Red/Brown/Skull). Needs a chosenRowAtCastStart source mirroring chosenColumnAtCastStart (color / skulls filters, several sources summed).
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:7316 -> "explode 24 ; ... dmg E11 178" (row 3 of the review board has 2 Red, 1 Brown, 0 Skull: native 26 + 8 x 3 = 50).

summary: Native StormRedPurple (Hellstorm) is a two-colour storm. Engine storms take one colour, so curated 8560/8562 and weapon 7xxx (batch-w03 Hellstorm) approximate it as a Red storm (Firestorm). Needs a storm spec with two colours (both colours weighted in refills), then curated Hellstorm skills switch to it.
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:7036 -> "storm Red set" (native StormRedPurple).

summary: Native ExplodeColor/DestroyColor BadGargoyle (or GoodGargoyle) and CountGems BadGargoyle/GoodGargoyle select one Gargoyle tier. Engine special-gem clear targets (randomGems special / special) and the boardSpecial / destroyedGems special sources match on kind only, so gargoyleGem tier 1 (Good) and tier 2 (Bad) are merged. troop:7851 Seditius "explode 3 Bad Gargoyle Gems" can explode Good ones. Needs an optional tier filter on special clear targets and on special count sources.
repro: castSpell({key:"troop:7851", board: withCells(reviewBoard,{"6,1":specialGem("gargoyleGem",1)})}) -> the Good gargoyle at 6,1 is exploded (native: only Bad).
